subtitle: Expenses in any currency
promotionalText: Record everyday and travel expenses in your home currency, attach receipts, and schedule recurring expenses. No account required.
description:
SpendRecorder helps you keep track of everyday and travel expenses. Enter an amount, choose a vendor and category, and attach a receipt photo if you need one.

TRACK EXPENSES IN DIFFERENT CURRENCIES
Record an expense in the currency you paid and see the equivalent in your home currency. See the exchange rate and its source, or enter the rate you actually paid. Each expense keeps the rate saved with it.

RECORD RECURRING EXPENSES
Set a schedule for expenses such as internet service or subscriptions. SpendRecorder posts due expenses automatically when the app is open. Each occurrence has its own record. Edit the latest occurrence to update future postings.

FIND AND REVIEW YOUR SPENDING
Search your expense history and view totals by month, year, category or vendor. Open a summary row to see the underlying expenses.

TAKE YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
Import and export Excel or CSV files. Save a copy to Files or share it using the iPhone or iPad share sheet.

Your expense records are stored on your device. No account or sign-in is required. Internet access is used for current and historical exchange-rate lookups.
notes: No account or demo credentials are required. On first launch, check the Terms acceptance box and tap Accept. In New, enter an amount, choose or add a vendor, and add the expense. To verify multiple currencies, tap the currency code beside the amount and choose PHP or USD. The amount screen shows the exchange rate and its source. Tap the rate to enter your own. To test recurrence, select Recurring expense, choose a frequency, and save. The app posts due occurrences while it is open. In History, review, edit, or delete an expense. In Summary, view totals, change home currency, and use Export or Import file. The receipt photo field opens the system photo chooser. The app stores records locally and contacts public exchange-rate services for rates.
